alphapartners-baseten:ashbyhq:b6a7e52e-b.title: Procurement Lead
alphapartners-baseten:ashbyhq:b6a7e52e-b.description: ABOUT BASETEN Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to to ship AI products. THE ROLE We're looking for a Procurement Lead to build Baseten's procurement function from the ground up. This is a foundational, high-ownership role for someone who wants to define how a company runs procurement, not inherit an existing process. As the company scales across engineering, GTM, and corporate functions, we need to build purchasing workflows and vendor relationships. This is a rare, critical-moment hire: you'll set the leading-practice processes, systems, and policies that the company runs on as it continues to grow, with the mandate and dedicated focus to build something built to scale. This role exists to make procurement a source of leverage for the business, not friction. Your goal is to build scalable process, take on vendor management and RFP work that today sits informally with individual teams, and free up business owners' time and capacity, all while building the guardrails the company needs as it grows. You'll partner closely with Finance, Legal, Security, Compliance, IT, and business owners across the company, and you'll be judged on whether teams feel supported and unblocked, not slowed down. RESPONSIBILITIES Procurement Strategy and Process - Design and implement Baseten's first company-wide procurement process, approval routing, and other workflows - Establish procurement policies (spend thresholds, approval authority, competitive bidding requirements) tailored to a high-growth business - Design processes that scale with the business without adding friction or slowing down how teams buy - Define procurement's operating model and roadmap as the function and team scale Systems and Tooling - Build out procurement workflows within our existing P2P platform, including requisition, approval, and purchase order processes - Build reporting and visibility into company-wide spend by category, vendor, and department Vendor Management and Sourcing - Own vendor onboarding, due diligence, and risk assessment across the company's vendor base, partnering with Security, Compliance, and Legal on vendor risk reviews - Lead or support strategic sourcing, RFPs, and contract negotiations on behalf of business owners, freeing up their time and capacity - Build a vendor management framework covering performance, risk, and renewals Cross-Functional Partnership - Partner with Legal, Security, Compliance, IT, and business owners across the company to understand purchasing needs and build workflows that fit how each team actually operates - Act as a trusted advisor and extension of business teams on sourcing strategy, RFPs, and vendor selection, not a gatekeeper that slows deals down Compliance and Controls - Establish procurement controls that support audit readiness, SOX compliance, and security and data privacy requirements as the company matures, in partnership with Legal, Security, and Compliance REQUIREMENTS - 8+ years of progressive procurement experience, including experience building or significantly maturing a procurement function at a high-growth technology company - Proven experience designing procurement processes, policies, and systems from the ground up - Experience running RFPs and vendor selection processes on behalf of business stakeholders - Experience with strategic sourcing and vendor contract negotiation across multiple spend categories - Experience partnering with Security, Compliance, and Legal on vendor r

cic-cic:lever:dbd2fe90-d0e8-4491-834b-49.description: Program Lead VCF(Venture Café Fukuoka) Are you thrilled by the sight of a well-coordinated gathering? Passionate about bringing people together for common interests? And find joy in collaborating with others to create their ideal event? If that sounds like you, we've got something special to share. CIC and Venture Café are on the hunt for a charismatic and meticulous Program Lead Venture Cafe’ Fukuoka. This role is perfect for someone with extensive experience in orchestrating, curating, and spearheading diverse events and programs. ABOUT CIC FUKUOKA & VENTURE CAFÉ FUKUOKA CIC Fukuoka combines flexible workspace and high-impact programming to serve as a physical center of gravity for the region’s innovation community, connecting Fukuoka to CIC’s global innovation ecosystem. As CIC’s second innovation campus in Japan and tenth worldwide, CIC Fukuoka occupies the 7th floor of the One Fukuoka Building (approximately 3,500 m²). The campus includes around 140 private offices, a coworking space with 40 seats, conference rooms, a kitchen café, a game room, and other shared amenities. Venture Café Fukuoka,a partner of CIC, aims to be an innovation activator by uniting the ecosystem through its events and programs. Dedicated to fostering a community and linking innovators globally, it will host weekly programs open to the public, attracting a diverse group of participants. These regular events signify the collaborative effort between Venture Café and CIC. Learn more about us here . YOUR DAY-TO-DAY WORK In this role, you will utilize a broad skill set encompassing planning, communication, negotiation, and time management, while effectively handling pressure. You will take charge of all aspects of CIC Fukuoka and Venture Café Fukuoka’s events, from planning and coordination to execution and evaluation.As the Program Lead VCF, you will be acting as the growth engine of Venture Café Fukuoka. It is a bridge between the Program Manager (Strategic Alignment) and the Program Coordinator (Operational Excellence), which has the core mission of"Growth & Innovation. " Together with the team, you will convert strategic vision into high-impact community experiences. You will design and deliver brand-new, impactful programs, drive new audience acquisition, and continuously inject fresh value into our flagship Thursday Gathering (TG) and broader community. You will also utilize data insights from SNS and collaborate directly with the Director. Not only creating programs and events as Venture Cafe’ Fukuoka but also executing events within CIC Fukuoka to foster deeper ecosystem integration. Potential responsibilities will include: ・ Introducing innovative ideas to enhance event quality, coordinating and delegating tasks within the team, and collaborating with technicians and industry experts to ensure seamless event experiences.Creation of new program from design to deliver innovative programs and sessions aligned with Venture Café Fukuoka’s strategic direction. ・ Drive new participant acquisition and expand community reach through creative experience design. ・ Create opportunities by data driven methodology, which include analyzing social media and digital engagement data (e.g., LinkedIn, Instagram, website traffic) to identify emerging trends, market gaps, and community needs. ・ Translate data insights into actionable programming strategies and new event opportunities. ・ Value creation to Thursday Gathering by actively participating in TGs with an R&D mindset to observe community dynamics and test new networking or experiential formats. ・ Brainstorm and align with the Director on-site to continuously update and elevate the value proposition of the community experience. ・ Strategically planing and, design, and execute high-profile events to enhance collaboration with CIC Fukuoka to bridge the venture community and drive ecosystem synergy. ・ Collaborate closely with the Program Manager to ensure all new initiatives align with overall strategy and resour
